method: means of the valid raw codes (<= 65499) in 120 x 120 pixel blocks of the 30 arc-second GeoTIFF (1 degree, 360 x 140, 80N to 60S), rounded; 65535 where a block has no valid pixel; written as a uint16 LZW strip GeoTIFF with ModelTiepoint and ModelPixelScale; values x 0.1 = g C m-2 yr-1
license: NASA-funded MODIS product, openly distributed by NTSG with no stated restrictions; NASA Earth Science data policy (open data, no restrictions)
citation: Zhao, M., Heinsch, F. A., Nemani, R. R., & Running, S. W. (2005). Improvements of the MODIS terrestrial gross and net primary production global data set. Remote Sensing of Environment, 95, 164-176. Also: Zhao, M., & Running, S. W. (2010). Drought-induced reduction in global terrestrial net primary production from 2000 through 2009. Science, 329, 940-943.
